name: Which mode shifts the velocity? (A/B/C at l = 20°)
question: On 19-11, with 300 kHz centred (auto), the line came out shifted by −5 to −6.5 km/s. Is it the 300 kHz throw, the centring, or the night?
why: The same tile, pass after pass, in three modes: A = 600 kHz centred on 0 (like 12-11, which matches HI4PI to +0.06 km/s), B = 300 kHz centred auto (like 19-11), C = 300 kHz centred on 0. If B shifts and C does not, it is the centring; if B and C both shift, it is the throw; if none shifts, it was the night. The whole profile is compared, never the peak.
